note: Credits for ideas, tools and pictures the Growing Together lessons draw on. Shown on the About page under Acknowledgments and Credits. Add a lesson here (lesson id, title, credit sentences) instead of putting credits inside a lesson.

lessons.title: Sharing Jesus with Others
credits: The BLESS rhythms are adapted from BLESS: 5 Everyday Ways to Love Your Neighbor and Change the World by Dave Ferguson and Jon Ferguson. The picture of one beggar telling another where to find bread comes from D. T. Niles.

lessons.title: The Biblical Storyline
credits: This lesson draws on the Creation, Fall, Redemption, Restoration framework widely used in gospel-centered Bible teaching.

lessons.title: How to Study the Bible
credits: This lesson draws on the inductive study method taught in Living by the Book by Howard G. Hendricks and William D. Hendricks.

lessons.title: Repentance and the Learning Circle
credits: This lesson draws on the Learning Circle from 3DM Ministries. The line about the whole life of a believer being one of repentance is retold from the first of Martin Luther's 95 Theses.

lessons.title: Discovering Your Gifts
credits: The APEST language for Ephesians 4:11 comes from Alan Hirsch.

lessons.title: Suffering and Trials
credits: The mosaic picture in this lesson draws on Desiring God by John Piper.

lessons.title: Worship and the Glory of God
credits: The ideas that God is honored most when He is your greatest joy, and that worship magnifies God the way a telescope shows a star, draw on John Piper's Desiring God and Don't Waste Your Life. "Missions exists because worship doesn't" is from John Piper's Let the Nations Be Glad.

lessons.title: Marriage and Relationships
credits: This lesson draws on The Meaning of Marriage by Tim and Kathy Keller.

lessons.title: BLESS - Begin in Prayer
credits: The BLESS rhythms are adapted from BLESS: 5 Everyday Ways to Love Your Neighbor and Change the World by Dave Ferguson and Jon Ferguson.

lessons.title: BLESS - Listen and Eat - Show Hospitality
credits: The BLESS rhythms are adapted from BLESS: 5 Everyday Ways to Love Your Neighbor and Change the World by Dave Ferguson and Jon Ferguson. This lesson also draws on writing about hospitality by David Mathis and Matt Chandler.

lessons.title: BLESS - Serve with Loving Sacrifice
credits: The BLESS rhythms are adapted from BLESS: 5 Everyday Ways to Love Your Neighbor and Change the World by Dave Ferguson and Jon Ferguson.

lessons.title: BLESS - Share Your Story and the Gospel
credits: The BLESS rhythms are adapted from BLESS: 5 Everyday Ways to Love Your Neighbor and Change the World by Dave Ferguson and Jon Ferguson. The 3 Circles is adapted from the 3 Circles Life Conversation Guide from the North American Mission Board.
The weekly question "Who did you BLESS this week?" comes from the KC Underground BLESS guide.

lessons.title: Faith at Work and School
credits: This lesson draws on Every Good Endeavor by Tim Keller and Don't Waste Your Life by John Piper.

lessons.title: How to Disciple Others
credits: Further reading: The Disciple Maker's Handbook by Bobby Harrington and Josh Robert Patrick; Discipleship Essentials by Greg Ogden; and The Master Plan of Evangelism by Robert Coleman.

lessons.title: Partners in the Mission
credits: This lesson draws on "Why Plant Churches" by Tim Keller and Let the Nations Be Glad by John Piper.
